{{Quote|And always, just when I went past this storm-blasted Millennium Oak, I used to hear his ethereal voice coming from nowhere saying, 'Lancer to Queen's Second Plane 4' ''[&hellip;]'' and I always used to stop still, raise one finger, and say, 'I shall make a note,' before continuing with my walk.|Haaran Balmor, "An Interview With Haaran Balmor, Jedi Master"|<ref name="GG9" />}}
The '''Millennium Oak''' was type of [[oak tree]]. One storm-blasted Millennium Oak grew in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the celestial body [[Damualer Triac]]. Over a period of nearly forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haaran Balmor]] took walks through the forest and, when they were passing the Millennium Oak, they would regularly be contacted [[Projective Telepathy|telepathically]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hart Daele]], who would then let Balmor know of his intended move in the [[Divoran holochess]] game they were playing.

==Description==
The Millennium Oak was a type of [[oak tree]], at least one storm-blasted specimen of which grew in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on<ref name="GG9" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Damualer Triac">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Damualer Triac system/Legends|Damualer Triac system]]</ref> celestial body [[Damualer Triac]].

==History==
[[File:GridSquareO10-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A Millennium Oak grew on Damualer Triac (Damualer Triac's galactic vicinity pictured).]]
At some point, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haaran Balmor]], who resided on Damualer Triac, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hart Daele]], who was stationed in the [[Samarine Province]]<ref name="GG9" /> [[Sector/Legends|subsector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 3.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-04-12}}</ref> approximately seven [[kiloparsec]]s away, engaged in a mutual marathon [[Divoran holochess]] competition spanning almost forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. As part of their routine, while Balmor was taking a walk through the forest and passing the storm-blasted Millennium Oak, Daele would [[Projective Telepathy|telepathically]] contact the other Jedi and let them know of his intended move in the pair's [[Holochess/Legends|chess]] game. In turn, Balmor would remark that they would note the move and then proceed with their walk. Some time later, the Jedi Master mentioned the Millennium Oak in an account of the game with Daele in an interview, titled "[[An Interview With Haaran Balmor, Jedi Master]]," that was included in [[Madelein Aurin]]'s [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Heroes Of The Republic]]''.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Millennium Oak was mentioned in "[[The Divoran Holochess Players]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' that was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="GG9" />
